::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_intents/{pi}/attempts"}
#docs
Each attempt is one interaction with the gateway. `span_id` correlates an attempt with its gateway request/response logs; `trace_id` is the request or job that made it.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `pi` | `string` | **yes** | Payment intent id (pi_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `payment_attempt`. One of `payment_attempt`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The payment attempt's id (pia_…). |
| `data.attempt_number` | `integer` | 1-based; unique per intent. Earlier attempts are never mutated by a retry. |
| `data.status` | `string` | The attempt's status. One of `inited`, `requires_action`, `authorized`, `consumed`, `failed`, `voided`. |
| `data.id_at_gateway` | `string` | The attempt's id at the gateway. |
| `data.error_code` | `string` | The gateway's error code, if the attempt failed. |
| `data.error_text` | `string` | The gateway's error message, if the attempt failed. |
| `data.trace_id` | `string` | The request or job that made this attempt. |
| `data.span_id` | `string` | This attempt's gateway request/response logs share this id, across requests. Null on older attempts. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the payment attempt was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the payment attempt was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.resource_version` | `integer` | A number that goes up on every change. |
| `data.payment_method` | `string` | Null when the attempt named no instrument (a `setup` intent before the buyer supplies one), or when the vaulted method has since been deleted — an attempt keeps no FK, so its history survives the card. |
| `data.payment_method_type` | `string` | `card` \| `upi` \| `wallet` \| … |
| `data.payment_method_brand` | `string` | The card brand used. |
| `data.payment_method_last4` | `string` | The last four digits of the card used. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such payment intent |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/payment_intents/pi_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/attempts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
:::code-group
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "payment_attempt",
      "id": "pia_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
      "attempt_number": 0,
      "status": "inited"
    }
  ]
}
```
```json [404 Not Found]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "No such payment intent"
  }
}
```
